question: Should ClickClack adopt native per-user emoji reactions as a supported core message interaction across channel messages, direct messages, and threads?
rationale: The implementation appears coherent and has substantial behavior proof, but deciding whether this new persistent interaction belongs in the core product is a maintainer product decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Sponsor native reactions
options.body: Accept reactions as a core ClickClack interaction and proceed with final source, generated-asset, and API review.

options.title: Keep reactions out of core
options.body: Decline the new core interaction surface and close or redirect the proposal with an explicit alternative product boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor native reactions
recommendation.body: Accept reactions as a core ClickClack interaction and proceed with final source, generated-asset, and API review.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the current implementation and can address follow-up feedback, though current-main feature ownership could not be established from the available inspection environment.
